sections.name: year
sections.desc: A soil with a constant pH of 7.
sections.sig: < year (pH depth year pH depth year ...) >

attrs.name: pH depth year
attrs.doc:
pH as a function of depth and calendar year. If specified, Daisy will interpolate
     between depth and between years. By default, a pH of 7 is assumed.
        <    year pH depth      >

attrs.name: – pH depth
attrs.doc: pH as a function of depth.

sections.text:
A soil with a constant pH of 7.
  < year (pH depth year pH depth year ...) >

    pH depth year : submodel (see section 4.1.7) sequence
     pH as a function of depth and calendar year. If specified, Daisy will interpolate
     between depth and between years. By default, a pH of 7 is assumed.
        <    year pH depth      >

        – year : integer
          Parameter
          Calendar year.
        – pH depth: plf [cm → pH]
          Parameter
          pH as a function of depth.
